people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Jehoshaphat
people.line: Son of Asa, king of Judah.

translations.web: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “Didn’t I tell you that he would not prophesy good concerning me, but evil?”
translations.bsb: Then the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “Did I not tell you that he never prophesies good for me, but only bad?”
translations.kjv: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, Did I not tell thee that he would not prophesy good unto me, but evil?
translations.asv: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, Did I not tell thee that he would not prophesy good concerning me, but evil?
